tokens.npc_dota_hero_legion_commander_bio:
They came without warning. Within the city walls of Stonehall there came a rumble and a terrible sound, and from blackness unknown came a force of beasts numbering beyond count, wielding flame and foul sorcery, slaying and snatching mothers and sons to dark purpose. Of once-mighty Stonehall's military strength only the Bronze Legion, led by the indomitable Commander Tresdin, was near enough to answer the call of battle. They rode into their city, fighting through bloodstained alleyways and burning markets, cutting their way through the monstrous throng to the source of the sudden invasion: an ethereal rift within the city square, and at its precipice thundered their dreaded champion.

Enwrapped in a corrosive shimmer, the leader of the abyssal horde swung its massive blade, cleaving a legionnaire in two as his flesh began to spoil. Tresdin lifted her blood-stained sword and settled her sights on the beast. It turned, smiling at her through a maze of teeth. Heedless of the battle raging around them, they charged one another.

Deflecting blow after blow, the pair danced their deadly duel as the Bronze Legion met its end around them. Tresdin leapt forward as her foe swung its sword to meet her. The odds turned. The attack smashed into Tresdin suddenly, a brutal thrust from the side, but even as her balance slipped she rallied her strength for another stroke. Blade scraped on blade, beyond the hilt to the gnarled paw below, carving it in two in a fearsome spray of sparks and blood. The vile audience looked on in astonishment as she pressed the attack, driving her blade through her foe's flesh into the stampeding heart within. With a scream that split the clouds above, the beast erupted in a torrent of gore and anguish. The stygian portal wavered, the power sustaining the chasm beyond vanishing as suddenly as it had appeared. The remaining invaders fell quickly to Stonehall steel.

Though victorious, the survivors saw little to celebrate: the city lay in ruins, and survivors were few. Fires continued to spread. Unfurling her banners of war, Tresdin gathered what allies she could. Her anger smoldered as she pledged brutal vengeance upon the forces of the abyss, and damned be any who would dare stand in her way.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_legion_commander_hype: Marching across the battlefield, Legion Commander challenges lone enemies in single combat. Each duel she wins increases the power of her attacks, until at last she can become a relentless one-woman army.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_legion_commander_npedesc1: Increases power with each duel victory

fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** During the {{A|Legion Commander|Duel}}, Overwhelming Odds has the following properties:
*** Has an {{M|instant cast}} time.
*** Only Overwhelming Odds can be cast, regardless of {{M|faction}} and {{M|disable}} sources affecting either Duel targets.
** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
*** Immediately applies all ability effects to Tresdin regardless of the ability's animations.
** The ability effects are applied as follows on self:
**# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|legion_commander_overwhelming_odds}}
**#* Reapplying the buff updates the ability values on self.
**# {{cf|shdnotes}}
**#* {{Symbol|bonus db-all}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|legion_commander_overwhelming_odds_shield}}
**#** Applies a buff that grants Tresdin an all {{M|damage barrier}} based on the total {{M|spell damage}} dealt to enemy heroes within the radius. This is defined as:
**#*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Damage Barrier|Barrier]] {{=}} Σ[[Spell Damage|SpellDmg]] × {{ValueColor||{{#var:Overwhelming Odds type1 value3 shd}}|shd|x}}}}
**#** Considers affected {{M|clones}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} and {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
**#** Reapplying the [[damage barrier]] buff refreshes its duration, and does not update to the current values.
**#** {{M|HP Removal}} sources affects the barrier value prior affecting Tresdin's {{M|current health}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Affects the following units:
*** {{M|Fogged units}}.
*** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
** Does not affect the following units:
*** {{M|Couriers}}
*** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** The ability effects are applied as follows on enemy units:
**# The base {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
**# The bonus {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}. Applies a 0-damage instance to {{M|summons}}.
**#* Considers {{M|clones}} and most {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
**#* Does not consider the following units as {{M|summons}}:
**#** {{U|Shard Golem}}
**#** {{M|Dominated}} units.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, the ability effects are applied as follows on the affected allied unit:
***# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|legion_commander_press_the_attack}}
***#* Recasting the ability applies an independent buff instance.
***# The {{M|strong dispel}}.
***# {{Symbol|bonus t4l}} The {{M|debuff immunity}} component.
***#* Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
**** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Tresdin.
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-1.png|84px]][[File:Dota2 Cast Range to AoE Visualization icon-2-2.png|84px]]
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} changes the ability targeting functionality from unit-targeted to {{ValueColor||area-targeted|agh}}.
**** Can affect allied units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Press the Attack cast range}}+{{#var:Press the Attack type2 value1 agh}}}}|agh}}-distance away with the [[cast range]] and [[effect radius]].
**** The ability now considers {{M|doubletap}} as a {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} ground-targeted cast, and centers the radius around Tresdin.
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.
**** Does not affect the following units:
***** {{M|Hidden}} units.
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}}
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Does not apply the passive cast if the victor is the enemy {{A|Legion Commander|Duel}} target.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}} {{Symbol|Target|No}}
*** Passively self-casts a {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted Press the Attack of its corresponding level if Tresdin is the victor of the {{A|Legion Commander|Duel}}.
*** Works independently of this ability's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
*** Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.

fields.value: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: After a set number of incoming attacks, Tresdin counter-attacks with bonus lifesteal immediately.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: If procs while already attacking, Tresdin instant attacks the current attacking target.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Lifesteal is less effective when attacking creeps.

fields.name: buff2text
fields.value: Moment of Courage: The next attack will have maximum attack speed.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** The required incoming attacks tally reduces by 1 per successful attack applied to Tresdin, this includes the following sources:
**** {{M|Instant attack}} sources that can proc {{M|Attack modifiers}}.
**** {{M|Secondary attack}} sources that can proc {{M|Attack modifiers}}.
*** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Symbol|Tally}}
**** Once the tally counter reaches {{Code|TallyValue - 1}}, the next successful incoming attack procs all ability effects centered around Axe, and the tally buff is removed.
**** The tally counter last indefinitely and persists through {{M|death}}, except for the following conditions:
***** Upon Tresdin {{M|respawns}}.
***** Upon {{M|reincarnation}} source procs.
***** Upon leveling up Counter Helix.
*** Grants self {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|legion_commander_moment_of_courage_lifesteal}} with the following propertes:
**** Grants the {{M|attack speed}} bonus while removing the [[Attack Speed#Maximum Attack Speed|max attack speed]] cap for Tresdin.
**** Bonus {{M|lifesteal}}.
***** Stacks additively with other lifesteal sources.
**** The {{#var:Moment of Courage value4}}-second buff duration lasts for either its duration or until Tresdin lands an attack.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*** The [[instant attack]] applied have the following properties:
**** Can proc any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-hit effects}}, including the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|legion_commander_moment_of_courage_lifesteal}}.
**** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
**** Affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.

abilities: Duel forces a no-escape 1v1 that Legion almost always wins with damage stacked.

items: Linken's Sphere blocks Legion Commander's key single-target spell.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Legion Commander's targeted disable.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Legion Commander for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Legion Commander's physical attacks.
Force Staff creates distance from melee Legion Commander.
Assault Cuirass's armor aura blunts Legion Commander's physical damage.
To return burst damage to attackers.
